name: file-app
description: File management app - Next.js frontend, NestJS backend, nginx reverse proxy
//: Deliberately NOT an npm workspace. Each app installs its own deps so the Dockerfiles can copy a single app's package.json + package-lock.json and run an isolated `npm ci`. This root manifest exists only to host the git hooks and to fan tasks out to both apps.

scripts.lint: npm --prefix backend run lint:check && npm --prefix frontend run lint
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix backend run typecheck && npm --prefix frontend run typecheck
scripts.test: npm --prefix backend run test && npm --prefix frontend run test
scripts.build: npm --prefix backend run build && npm --prefix frontend run build
scripts.install:all: npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install
